meta.name: document-gen-unicode-safe
meta.description: Unicode-safe fallback workflow for multi-format document generation with character sanitization and explicit error capture

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成多格式文档并自动清理异常字符
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要生成 Word/PDF 等文档并确保字符安全
copy.tagline_en: Generate multi-format documents with automatic character sanitization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate Word/PDF documents with safe characters

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在生成多格式文档（DOCX、PDF、HTML）时，会手动分步创建 Markdown 源文件，先对 PDF 进行 Unicode 字符净化，再用 pandoc 转换，并捕获错误输出以便调试。
howto.when: 当 shell_agent 在复杂文档生成中返回未知或模糊错误时触发，尤其涉及多格式、特殊字符或非 ASCII 文本。

say.text: 生成一份包含弯引号和破折号的报告，分别输出DOCX和PDF。
say.note: 技能会手动分步执行，确保PDF字符安全。

say.text: 把我写的Markdown转成PDF，并替换所有Unicode特殊字符。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude manually splits document generation into steps: creates Markdown source, sanitizes Unicode characters for PDF, converts using pandoc, and captures stderr for debugging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when shell_agent returns unclear errors on complex document generation, especially with multiple formats, special characters, or non-ASCII text.

say_en.text: Generate a report with curly quotes and dashes, output DOCX and PDF.
say_en.note: Skill runs manual steps ensuring PDF character safety.

say_en.text: Convert my Markdown to PDF, replacing all Unicode special chars.
Create a doc with special symbols, try xelatex first, then wkhtmltopdf.
